g.text: Selected target packaging · three inference routes, GCS bucket, role-isolated checkpoints and one-command ingestion. Current Compose differs as shown below.
DOCKER HOST / PRIVATE SERVICE NETWORK · grouping, not a container
Each enabled role has its own runtime with automatic balanced routing. UI routing to additional roles is planned.
TEMPORARY JOB CONTAINERS · manual run order
Separate Qdrant and PostgreSQL data volumes
Volumes hold persistent data; they are not Docker containers. One image can supply multiple independent containers.
Shared BGE, four job entrypoints and release activation: implemented in source
GCS storage + conditional release pointer: implemented; cloud trial pending
Research / Interview runtimes, role isolation and balanced routing: remaining
Container acceptance and rollout are tracked in the roadmap
